experiment: C: a new candidate, M7R + M2R combined, under the M2R contract including its upload-latency phase gate. It is not a rerun of anything.
mechanism: reusable descriptor pool blocks plus per-usage device-local placement; host writes go directly into write-combined device-local buffers; readback stays cached with the zero-copy map

sampling.inputs: c1 frozen inputs and independent oracles
sampling.powerBasis: Same 192 pairs as M2R-2. The combined effects observed in the variant diagnostic are larger than M2R's, so 192 pairs exceeds the M2R-2 power basis.

metric: complete = compileNs + pipelineNs + resourcesNs + sum of every iteration's operation interval + teardownNs (CPU oracle excluded). Ratios are candidate/main per balanced pair; bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 20261029.

acceptance.primaryGate: complete CI95 upper < 1.0 on all three workloads
acceptance.statedPhaseAllowances: warm.upload median ratio <= 1.15 and resourcesNs median ratio <= 1.15 on each workload; every other warm phase, first.operation, setupNs, compileNs, pipelineNs and teardownNs ratio CI95 lower <= 1.05
acceptance.uploadLatencyPhaseGate: separate, for applications that depend on writeBuffer latency: warm.upload CI95 upper <= 1.02 on all three workloads. Recorded and reported; it does not change the primary verdict.
acceptance.verdict: primary pass only if every workload window is valid and primaryGate and statedPhaseAllowances hold

validity.perWindowGate: Each workload runs in its own timed window under the GPU lock, with the four participant units stopped. A window is INVALID if (a) foreign GPU busy averages more than 2% of window wall time, measured from amdgpu DRM fdinfo engine time of every client whose executable is not a doe-work harness binary, sampled every 250 ms throughout (device gpu_busy_percent sampled every 100 ms is recorded beside it); or (b) foreign CPU time exceeds 5% of window CPU capacity (window seconds x 32 CPUs), computed as /proc/stat busy jiffies minus the harness command tree (GNU time) minus the sampler; or (c) any process fails or misses an oracle; or (d) the A/A check fails: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median within [0.95,1.05] with CI95 containing 1. Process snapshots at window start and end are retained as receipts.
validity.invalidWindows: An invalid window is rerun fresh under the unchanged contract; its data are retained and never used for the verdict and never reinterpreted.

uploadRecoveryAttempts: Before freezing, one locked diagnostic window (c5/vdiag, gate-valid, 24 pairs) compared three variants. c-direct: complete vector 0.833 / image 0.864 / upload-readback 0.941, upload 1.128 / 1.088 / 0.974. c-stream (SSE2 non-temporal stores into write-combined mappings, confirmed movntdq in the build): complete 0.851 / 0.867 / 0.929, upload 1.121 / 1.047 / 0.997. c-staging (device-local storage with a pooled, never-reallocating cached staging ring copied at the head of the next submission): complete 0.896 / 0.993 / 1.058, upload 0.961 / 0.990 / 1.017. Persistent mapping is already Doe's behavior. No variant recovered upload without losing complete, and c-stream showed no benefit over c-direct, so the simpler c-direct is frozen.
